m: मा-वत् mfn. (for म-वत्, fr. 3. म) like me, RV. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 2, 39, Vārtt. 1, Pat.)
मावेल्ल m. N. of a son of Vasu (prince of Cedi), MBh.
मावेल्लक m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. (v.l. मावेलक and मावेल्वक).
मा—विलम्बम् (Pañcat.) ind. without delay, shortly, quickly (in commands).
मा-विलम्बम् ˚बितम्. See under 1. मा, p. 804, col. 2.
मा—विलम्बितम् (BhP.) ind. without delay, shortly, quickly (in commands).
